assets.title: Five ORM operations inside one boundary
assets.alt: Five ORM operations inside one boundary. Illustrative schematic, not a native capture.
assets.caption: What matters: event.save is the fifth operation missed by a four-method spy. The callback is awaited between creates. What to ignore: box width says nothing about duration. Option tracing alone does not prove native isolation.

assets.title: Three state facts before and after
assets.alt: Three state facts before and after. Illustrative schematic, not a native capture.
assets.caption: What matters: compare all three facts on named fixtures and distinguish unsafe from managed roles. What to ignore: these expected tuples are not your evidence. Recovery must be checked on the same failed instance.

assets.title: Actual local origin and supplied HTTP route
assets.alt: Actual local origin and supplied HTTP route. Illustrative schematic, not a native capture.
assets.caption: What matters: actual printed origin, method/path and distinct ORM/HTTP evidence. What to ignore: there is no live Network screenshot or guaranteed fixed port here. Do not kill foreign processes.
